bio: With its vibrant atmosphere and unique charm, this inviting self-proclaimed neo-Bavarian restaurant stands out from the crowd. It embodies a fusion of trendy, urban-casual vibes and cuisine inspired by the owner's Allgäu roots. In the four-course Schmankerl Menu, the 12-course Wirtshaus Maximus Menu and the small à la carte selection, Markus Stöckle transforms traditional dishes into original creations packed with flavour. A prime example is the Radi Wickerl (braised leaves, sansho, pickled kombu and radish). The wine list, which includes a selection of natural wines, is also impressive. The service is pleasingly down-to-earth and friendly – the charismatic proprietor is also on hand, making sure each guest feels well looked after....
